The task succeeded after the child used the screwdriver properly to assemble the frame and attach the shelves.

The child struggled with correctly applying the glass cleaner, likely failing to open the medicine cabinet to retrieve it or not spraying it directly on the mirror, and may have used improper wiping techniques such as straight strokes or a saturated cloth, leading to streaks.
